parameters.jsCode: const crypto = require('crypto'); const source = $json; const clean = value => String(value ?? '').normalize('NFC').replace(/\r\n?/g, '\n').trim(); const spaces = value => clean(value).split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).join(' '); const rawPhone = clean(source.phone); if (!/^[0-9\s()+.\-]+$/.test(rawPhone)) throw new Error('phone_invalid'); const digits = rawPhone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); const phone = digits.length === 8 && /^[89]/.test(digits) ? '65' + digits : digits; const months = { january: 'January', february: 'February', march: 'March', april: 'April', may: 'May', june: 'June', july: 'July', august: 'August', september: 'September', october: 'October', november: 'November', december: 'December' }; const month = months[spaces(source.birthday_month).toLowerCase()]; const consent = spaces(source.marketing_consent).toLowerCase(); if (!month || !['yes', 'no'].includes(consent)) throw new Error('source_consent_or_month_invalid'); const pdpa = source.pdpa_acknowledged === true || ['yes', 'i agree'].includes(spaces(source.pdpa_acknowledged).toLowerCase()); const payload = { name: spaces(source.name), phone, email: spaces(source.email).toLowerCase(), birthday_month: month, marketing_consent: consent === 'yes' ? 'Yes' : 'No', pdpa_acknowledged: pdpa }; const canonical = JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(payload).sort())); return [{ json: { schema_version: 'xb.member.source_event.v1', source_system: 'google_forms', form_alias: 'member_registration', response_id: source.responseId, create_time: source.createTime, mapping_version: 'member-intake.v1', request_id: 'n8n-' + crypto.randomUUID(), payload, payload_hash: 'sha256:' + crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonical, 'utf8').digest('hex'), operation: 'member.create' } }];
